description: Find repeated spending by payee (merchant or Pix recipient) and amount in an explicit period of at most 366 days. Monetary values use { amount, currency } with amount as an exact decimal string. Pending debits count and drop once posted. These are spending patterns, not confirmed subscriptions; fixed installments can resemble recurring charges. Cadence confidence is heuristic, not a probability; category confidence reflects recognized-category coverage. Own-account transfers (incl. Pix to your own CPF), card payments, refunds and investments are excluded. Separate refunds without a reliable provider link cannot be reconciled. At most 10,000 eligible transactions are analyzed; meta.historyComplete is false if more rows exist. Pass page.nextCursor unchanged. Pagination is best-effort. nextExpectedDate is predicted, not a bill.

description: Aggregate debit transactions by category, merchant, month, weekday, account, or statement over an explicit period of at most 366 days. Totals use { amount, currency } with amount as an exact decimal string; Currencies remain separate; bank-converted ones count in the account's. Category groups use the institution's label unless you set an override. Pending debits count by default and drop once posted. Internal transfers (incl. own-CPF Pix) are left out and reported under excluded unless includeInternalTransfers; generic TRANSFER is spending unless exclude has 'transfer'. exclude matches Mofi's classification (your override, else the provider category rule, else known operation codes). meta.warnings flags connections that hold the same bank data. Group keys: category 'override:<code>' (your override; drill down with mofi_transactions_get where.normalizedCode), 'value:<provider label>' (where.category) or 'unknown'; merchant 'value:<merchant>', 'description:<normalized description>' when the bank sent no merchant (where.search with a distinctive part), or 'unknown'. Pass page.nextCursor unchanged. For averages and top categories, prefer mofi_spending_summary_get.
name: mofi_spending_get

title: Get spending

description: Use this first for 'how much do I spend', monthly or weekly averages, and spending by category or merchant. Summarize debit spending over an explicit period of at most 366 days in one call: totals per month or ISO week (zero-spend periods included), the average over periods fully inside the range, and the top categories or merchants with the remainder. Totals use { amount, currency } with amount as an exact decimal string; Currencies remain separate; bank-converted ones count in the account's. Pending debits count by default and drop once posted. Internal transfers, card bill payments and investment moves are excluded by default and reported under excluded. Internal transfer is a simple heuristic: your category override is transfer, the provider category is 'Same person transfer', the operation code is an own-account transfer (incl. Pix to your own CPF), or a non-cancelled credit with the same currency and amount exists in another of your accounts within 3 days. A generic TRANSFER code alone is still spending. Card payments and investments match Mofi's classification: your override, else a bill-debit description, else the provider category rule, else known operation codes. Periods that have not ended yet are marked complete=false and left out of the average. meta.warnings flags connections that hold the same bank data. Breakdown keys follow mofi_spending_get group keys.

where.description: Inclusive period; optionally one account or one connection.

description: Find an owned transaction by transactionId, list all, or AND untagged where predicates. Legacy id lookups and tagged selectors remain accepted; continue legacy cursors with the same selector. Search matches description or merchant substrings. Periods require startDate, endDate and timezone. Pages contain 1-1000 rows (default 500); totalCount counts all matches. Money uses { amount, currency }: exact decimal magnitude plus CREDIT/DEBIT direction. operationType is raw; category carries provider and normalized values. Unknown/generic PURCHASE codes add no classification; known category labels can. Conflicting signals have no economic type; mixed vehicle tax/fee labels are not guessed. statementId links are included. Mofi stores POSTED when status is missing. For the same user, connection, and account, reimports with the same provider ID update the existing row; no prior versions are retained. Distinct IDs are not linked or deduplicated as pending-to-posted transitions. Pass page.nextCursor unchanged.
